quote.text: How many have laid waste to your life when you weren’t aware of what you were losing, how much was wasted in pointless grief, foolish joy, greedy desire, and social amusements—how little of your own was left to you. You will realize you are dying before your time!
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that the finite moments with family are precious; avoid getting lost in trivial pursuits that steal time from nurturing and understanding your children.
    • Embrace mindful parenting by choosing quality time and deep conversations over fleeting distractions, fostering genuine connections that last a lifetime.
  • Leadership
    • Understand that leadership is about making purposeful decisions; refrain from letting unimportant matters or social noise divert your focus from impactful actions.
    • Lead by example to ensure that both your time and your team’s efforts are dedicated to meaningful, value-driven goals rather than chasing transient, superficial achievements.
  • Product Management
    • Apply the wisdom of intentionality to product management by prioritizing initiatives that align with core user needs and long-term value, rather than getting sidetracked by fleeting trends.
    • Continuously evaluate and discard redundant features or processes, ensuring that each step in your product strategy contributes meaningfully to the overall vision and user satisfaction.
